entities.name: AWS
entities.rationale: Represents public cloud data sources (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, S3, etc.) depicted with an AWS VPC cloud icon.

entities.name: ON-PREM
entities.rationale: Represents on-premises data sources sending syslog/Kafka events.

entities.name: APACHE METRON
entities.rationale: Central stream processing and enrichment engine depicted with an AWS compute icon.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: Amazon EMR processing persistent data into S3, located inside the Security Data Lake dashed container.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 storing telemetry data long-term, located inside the Security Data Lake dashed container.

entities.name: ATHENA
entities.rationale: Amazon Athena querying telemetry data from S3, located inside the Security Data Lake dashed container.

entities.name: SOAR
entities.rationale: Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response platform depicted with an AWS compute icon.

entities.name: ALERTS
entities.rationale: SOC analysts receiving triage alerts depicted as a group of user icons.

entities.name: WAF
entities.rationale: AWS WAF / firewall target used for automated or manual incident mitigation and blocking.

visual_connections.description: Public cloud telemetry events ingested into Apache Metron
On-premises log events ingested into Apache Metron
Persistent data from Apache Metron processed by EMR
EMR writes processed telemetry data to S3
Athena queries telemetry data residing in S3
Feedback loop delivering long-term profiles and models back to Apache Metron
Alerts forwarded from Apache Metron to the SOAR framework
SOAR presents enriched alerts to SOC analysts
Analysts trigger remediation actions on WAF
